title: Public live cameras: where they are and whether they are up

provenance.by: sources/cams/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: Official cameras of public bodies and operators' own pages only, by link; each camera's terms are recorded in register/cams.json (terms_page, terms_summary, licence_link). We ask for the operator's page only, once an hour, and keep only whether it answered and whether it still carries a player: never a frame, snapshot or stream, no face or plate recognition, no recording. Never an unsecured private camera. Take-down on request. Rules confirmed by Dinis Cruz on 18 November 2026, about 19:00 UTC (official cameras only; the operator's own embed or a link; never record; MEO BeachCam through its official embeds; Windy's webcams API under its terms, attributed). Not reviewed by a person.

about: Public live cameras in the places we cover, from official operators only, each with its operator, place, coordinates, terms and licence link, and whether its operator's page is up. Status comes from the operator's page only; no frame, picture or stream is fetched, kept or analysed. Watch each camera on its operator's page.
rules: Official cameras only; the operator's own embed (an iframe from the operator's host) or a link; never record (Dinis, 18 Nov 2026, about 19:00 UTC)
MEO BeachCam included through its official camera pages; embed_allowed is true only where MEO's terms or official offer allow it
Windy webcams API allowed under its terms, attributed; no key held, API not called
Never fetch, store or describe a stream, frame or snapshot
Refusals (403, bot check) recorded as gaps, not worked around; beachcam.meo.pt was not fetched again
No private cameras or directories; private business only with its own public page, flagged

Since Dinis, 19 Nov 2026 ~17:40 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-19-cameras-as-links-and-the-map.md): MEO BeachCam (19 cameras) and SkylineWebcams (2) are credited links only, embed_allowed false, never fetched by code (check false). We embed or show in full only what we have full right to use (an open licence or the owner written permission); everything else is a credited link; nothing is re-hosted.
